_README: Manual candidate -> committee links for the Races map.
Consulted BEFORE any name matching, so it always wins. Use it only where
no matcher should be expected to guess -- a committee named nothing like
its candidate, or two plausible people in one district. Ordinary variants
subset -- one name's tokens contain the other's and surnames agree
fuzzy  -- token_sort_ratio >= 80 with an agreeing surname
Candidates that still match nothing are printed by
refresh_legislative_map.py and listed in /admin, so they can be linked
here rather than sitting silently at $0.
